task_completion.description: Navigate to the Language and Appearance section within Firefox Settings.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Firefox 'Settings' tab is open, and the 'Language and Appearance' section is visible or scrolled into view.

task_completion.description: Set the Default font to 'Verdana' and the Size to '24'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Default font' dropdown shows 'Verdana' and the 'Size' dropdown shows '24'.

task_completion.description: Open the Fonts 'Advanced...' menu and disable the checkbox allowing pages to choose their own fonts.
task_completion.visual_evidence: In the 'Fonts' advanced dialog, the checkbox 'Allow pages to choose their own fonts, instead of your selections above' is unchecked.

task_completion.description: In the Colors menu, set Text to Black and Background to Light Yellow.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Colors' dialog is open; the 'Text' color swatch is black (#000000) and the 'Background' color swatch is light yellow (#FFFFE0).

task_completion.description: Set the color override preference to 'Always'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: In the 'Colors' dialog, the dropdown for 'Override the colors specified by the page with your selections' is set to 'Always'.

task_completion.description: Close the browser to save settings.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The final screenshot shows the Firefox window has been closed or the process has terminated.

integrity.description: The agent used the Firefox GUI to change settings rather than editing configuration files via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with the Firefox Settings UI elements.

integrity.description: The agent did not use 'about:config' to bypass the requested menu navigation.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent is seen navigating through 'Settings > General' rather than typing 'about:config' in the address bar.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the actual Firefox application interface.
integrity.visual_evidence: The Firefox application window, menus, and dialog boxes are visible and active during the configuration process.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The task requires specific accessibility overrides in Firefox. Verdana and Size 24 must be set in the main settings. The 'Allow pages to choose their own fonts' checkbox is located inside the 'Advanced...' button under Fonts. The color settings (Black/Light Yellow) and the 'Always' override setting are located inside the 'Colors...' button menu. The browser must be closed at the end.
